proposals.evidence: DEDR 4666(b), distinct from earth/soil in (a), explicitly lists Tamil and Malayalam maṇal, Kannada maṇal/maḷal/maral, Kodagu maṇa and Parji/Gadaba man sand. Only this sand branch is selected; the Toda compound er-moḷṇ and earth responses under the sand prompt are excluded. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
